items.question: What is Clarity Group?
items.answer: Clarity Group is a premier corporate holding entity overseeing six subsidiaries spanning construction, technology, facilities management, manufacturing, recruitment, and global manpower — all operating under one certified standard.

items.question: Which industries does Clarity Group serve?
items.answer: Our subsidiaries deliver construction and engineering, IT and technology solutions, facilities management, precision manufacturing, and direct/indirect manpower supply to clients across process, marine, aviation, and built-environment sectors.

items.question: What certifications and licenses do you hold?
items.answer: Clarity Group holds ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environmental), and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety) certifications, ASPRI registration, and bizSAFE STAR status — audited at the holding level and applied across all subsidiary operations.

items.question: How does Clarity Group handle manpower deployment?
items.answer: Through Clarity E&C, our dedicated manpower subsidiary, we coordinate direct and indirect workforce deployment across multiple countries under a licensed recruitment framework — tracked on our interactive workforce map.

items.question: How can my company work with Clarity Group?
items.answer: Reach out via our contact page with your subsidiary of interest and project scope. Our team will route your inquiry to the relevant entity and respond with next steps.

items.question: Is Clarity Group hiring?
items.answer: Yes — each subsidiary lists open roles on our Careers page. Openings span site operations, engineering, technology, facilities, and manpower coordination.
